prompt:
Create a polished game-interface design exploration for the existing mobile strategy game New Opacha, inspired by the refined, playful clarity of Inkwell Stars. This is a UI component study, not a poster or illustration. Output a landscape 1200 x 900 sheet on an almost-white warm background, very generous whitespace, legible rounded Quicksand-like typography, minimal exact labels. Show a clean compact battlefield visual language. The user wants circular 3D nodes like M&M candy: shallow domed smooth candy BUTTONS, not spheres, with restrained highlights and very tight contact shadows. Mint green, soft cyan, warm white neutral nodes, charcoal numbers. NO letter M or candy brand logo. NO broad gray halos, no strokes crossing numerals, no type marks around a numeral, no noisy textures, no grunge, no decorative frames, no device mockup.
Use identical composition and game information for comparing alternatives:
At top, a small simple title naming the variant.
Upper third: four enlarged candy-node samples, with centered clear numbers 15, 35, 3, 120. One plain, one shielded, one upgraded, one selected. Upgrade glyphs and shield information sit OUTSIDE the centered number area in a consistent compact position. Include a tiny AI crown above one sample, separated from a shield/flag. Do not overlap symbols.
Middle third: a compact playable-looking triangle of three smaller nodes with numbers 15, 35, 3, joined by three routes. Show one neutral route, one faction-owned directional route, and one dashed construction route. Routes stop with a clear gap BEFORE node outlines or shields. One tiny moving troop group has the number 12 on a rounded clean capsule beside a route. The direction marker and number remain separate from the node. Construction cost 80 is a small white-backed label beside its route. No menus or slider.
Bottom third: a single small row of six consistent game symbols: shield, economy/growth, artillery, bomb, AI crown, flag. Draw real clean geometric icons, not emoji. Below that row, include one dark-navy strip with two node samples and one route to prove the same style in night mode. Numbers must remain readable.
Typography is crisp, all numerals upright and centered. Keep icons proportionate and restrained. The attached gameplay screenshot is reference for product context only; clean up its overlaps and visual clutter, do not reproduce its messy graphics.
VARIANT B — title exactly "B · Soft satin". Rounded shallow candy faces with a broad satin highlight and quiet lower edge, almost no visible dark contour, extremely soft tight shadow. Shields use one compact shield-icon-and-number badge reading 4 on a small warm-white pill attached just outside the lower-right edge; no extra rings around shielded nodes. Selected state uses a very fine gold ring. Routes are single muted faction-colored strokes, neutral routes gray, tiny simple chevron direction markers. Icons are compact solid silhouettes with clean cutouts, never chunky. This is the calmest, softest and least busy alternative. Retain enough contrast to distinguish each node edge.
